limitations: Browser measurements are animation-frame intervals, not GPU completion or input-to-display latency.
The runner is capped around 60 Hz; these results do not establish 120 Hz performance.
The before/after browser comparison includes removal of development instrumentation. It is not a renderer throughput improvement or a production-build comparison.
CPU timings vary with JIT warm-up, garbage collection and machine load; the small benchmark is diagnostic, not a universal performance guarantee.
The shared preview had no WebGPU adapter; browser runs used isolated local Chrome contexts.
